title: Administrators
description:

Location - Belfast & surrounding areas

Hours of Work - Monday to Friday (Full time and Part time hours available)

Word processing / audio working letters / producing reports. Sorting and responding to mail as appropriate. Dealing with general enquiries. Maintaining diaries. Minute taking. Arranging meetings. title: Sales Administrator
description:
Honeycomb is delighted to be working alongside our client, a reputable business to recruit a Sales Administrator on a full-time permanent basis. Our client is experiencing continual demand within the industry making it an excellent time to join a well-established team. This is a varied role and presents great opportunities for someone wanting to pursue a long-term career.

The Role
- End to end order management, including quotations, order processing and invoicing.
- Assisting in the management of stock and pricing.
- Providing insight and knowledge to customers regarding the product range.
- Building strong relationships with both customers and suppliers.

The Person
- Previous experience working within administration and order processing, customer focused with the ability to provide high level service.
- You will have a keen desire to learn and be proficient in all MS Packages and CRM.
- Possess excellent time management skills with the ability to work towards deadlines.
- Personable and able to build long term relationships.

The package for this role includes a salary of £28,000- £32,000 depending on experience, this role presents with a sociable working week of Monday- Friday. Based on site in the Belfast area, this role presents the opportunity to work within a tight knit team with excellent opportunities for long term development.

To speak in absolute confidence about this opportunity please send an up-to-date CV via the link provided or contact Shanice Mackin, Specialist Senior Recruitment Consultant, at Honeycomb on the number provided.

If you have a disability which means you require assistance at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us directly to discuss.

Honeycomb is committed to providing equality of opportunity to all.

Please note, we are receiving an exceptionally high number of applications and present and will be unable to shortlist candidates who are not meeting the specific requirements for this role. Due to the high volume of applications, we may be unable to provide individual feedback. We thank you in advance for your understanding.

title: Part-time Administrator
description:
The Union of Shop, Distributive and Allied Workers is one of the UK s largest trade unions.

A vacancy exists for a Part-time Administrator based at the Union s Belfast Office.

Please note that this position is fully office based.

This is a readvertisement and previous applicants need not apply.

What we Offer:
- Defined contribution pension.
- Generous holiday entitlement 24 days rising to 32 days plus 8 bank and 3 customary holidays (pro-rata to commencing month in holiday year and number of days a week worked).
- Free onsite parking, subject to availability.
- Free health assessments (post probation).
- Cycle to Work Scheme (subject to passing probation and length of contract).
- Season Ticket Loan (subject to length of contract).

The Union does not currently offer sponsorship.

Principal duties are: to provide a typing and clerical service, assisting in the provision of help and advice to members.

The successful applicant will possess: telephone and reception skills; the ability to work harmoniously in a small team and with individual colleagues; demonstrates tact, initiative and discretion; the ability to communicate effectively; well-developed planning and organisational skills and the ability to prioritise work in order to meet deadlines; IT literacy, particularly Microsoft Office, including Word and Excel.

An application pack can be downloaded from here by clicking on the apply button.

The closing date is noon on 24 August 2026.

CVs are not accepted. No agencies please.

Usdaw is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

title: Sales Support Specialist
description:
Sales Support Specialist - Belfast

Salary: £28,100 per annum

Location: Belfast City Centre

Working hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:30pm

Working model: Office-based

Start date: 21 September

Are you highly organised, commercially minded and confident working with data, systems and sales processes?

We're recruiting a Sales Support Specialist to join a busy Belfast-based operation. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and wants to build their career within sales operations, commercial support and process improvement.

You'll act as a trusted point of support for sales teams, helping to keep the entire sales cycle running smoothly. From quotations and purchase orders through to bookings, invoicing and data management, you'll play an important role in ensuring processes are accurate, efficient and delivered to a high standard.

What you'll be doing
- Preparing quotes for contract renewals and RFP/RFI responses
- Maintaining accurate pricing, configuration and quotation documentation
- Managing and updating information across internal systems and databases
- Working extensively with Excel spreadsheets and business data
- Responding professionally to internal and external queries
- Processing Purchase Orders and managing order bookings and reconciliations
- Supporting quoting, booking and invoicing workflows
- Completing quality assurance checks to maintain accuracy and consistency
- Identifying opportunities to improve processes and ways of working
- Managing medium to high-priority queries and escalations
- Maintaining and improving internal knowledge resources
- Identifying potential operational risks and communicating these appropriately
- Supporting and mentoring junior colleagues
- Using approved AI and automation tools to streamline processes and identify opportunities for improvement

What we're looking for

You'll be someone who takes pride in getting the details right while being comfortable juggling competing priorities.

Ideally, you'll have:
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word
- Excellent attention to detail
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- The ability to work confidently with confidential information
- Strong organisational and time-management skills
- The ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines
- A proactive approach to identifying and solving problems
- Confidence learning new systems and technology
- An interest in using AI and automation to improve business processes
- A customer-focused and professional approach
- Confidence communicating with stakeholders at different levels
- The ability to remain calm and organised when working to tight deadlines
- The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a wider team

Experience using Salesforce or another CRM system would be advantageous, although it isn't essential.

A Diploma or Degree and up to two years of relevant experience would also be beneficial.

What's on offer?
- £28,100 annual salary
- Monday-Friday working hours - no weekend shifts
- Belfast City Centre office
- Training and development opportunities
- Career progression opportunities
- Leadership development programmes
- Paid annual leave, holidays and sick leave
- Wellness programmes and initiatives
- Employee recognition programmes
- Referral bonus opportunities
- Inclusive and supportive working environment
- Volunteer and community involvement opportunities

Interested?

If you have experience in sales support, sales administration, order processing, quotations, invoicing, CRM systems, Excel or commercial operations, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV for immediate consideration.

Start date: 21 September - early applications are encouraged.
